correctness.rationale: The median is continuous and linear on each closed order cone. Split a segment at its finitely many isolated coordinate-order ties; ties holding on the entire segment can be resolved by any consistent order because tied coordinates coincide on that segment. The triangle inequality bounds the global modulus by the largest induced selector norm. Conversely a sufficiently small top-eigenvector perturbation of any strict chamber point attains a selector norm there. I independently rebuilt the eight dihedral classes from 120 orders, the eight determinant polynomials, and the 20 nonnegative integer coefficient certificates. For selector (0,0,3,2,0) the generalized roots are 0 (twice), 1, R, and (6g²+5g+1)/d<R. The sixth selector has two zeros, 1 and the two quadratic roots with upper root C as stated. Its substitution gives F(g,C)<0 for C>2; the signs at 1 and 2 and the cubic leading sign locate one root in each of (−∞,1), (1,2), (2,∞), so C<B. All other excluded classes are strictly below R by positive leading minors or isospectrality. For R>2, F(g,R)=−H/d identifies the branch order, and one sign variation with H(0)<0 implies exactly one positive simple crossing, confirmed numerically at 0.3707963445579808775. The limits follow from F(0,z)=(z−1)(z−2)² and the normalized leading large-g cubic. Replay: python /workspace/branches/replay_four.py. The frozen checker was read, not executed.
residual_risks: The endpoint g=∞ is a limiting modulus, not a positive-definite norm at infinity.

value.rationale: The five-cycle is the smallest odd periodic size with a genuinely local three-site median window. A worst-case two-input amplification bound is a natural stability invariant, and an arbitrary choice of a small or large g would miss the change of extremizers. The full function gives an exact benchmark and shows why a single selector formula cannot extend across the positive coupling range.
residual_risks: Confined to the specific cycle, equal edge weights and window size; no algorithmic minimax-risk improvement is shown.
